question: Why did the error rate go up on 07 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New UI flow feature flag change introduced a bug in the catalog v3.14 release.
why_chain: The new UI flow feature flag was changed to 50% in record R011, which occurred 3 minutes before the error rate spike.
The catalog v3.14 release (record R012) was deployed 2 minutes before the error rate spike.
The NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (record R013 and R014) occurred 3 and 8 minutes after the catalog v3.14 release.
The error rate increased from 0.37% to 2.04% (record E1), indicating a new issue introduced by the catalog v3.14 release.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in request volume caused the error rate to spike.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume stayed about the same (record E3), and the p95 latency also stayed about the same (record E4).

ruled_out.hypothesis: The deployment of catalog v3.14 caused the error rate to spike.
ruled_out.reason: The error rate spike occurred after the catalog v3.14 deployment (record E5), but the error rate increase was not immediately after the deployment.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog in region us-east rose from 0.37% to 2.04% (+446%), with a change point at 2026-03-07T05:25:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog in region us-east: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.12).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog in region us-east stayed about the same (735 per 5 min before, 852 per 5 min after, +16%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog in region us-east stayed about the same (121 ms before, 120 ms after, -1%).
Deployed catalog v3.14 to us-east (catalog, us-east; 2 min before the change; record R012)
Changed catalog feature flag new_ui_flow to 50% in us-east (catalog, us-east; 3 min before the change; record R011)
High error rate on catalog in us-east (catalog, us-east; 10 min after the change; record R015)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.14) (catalog, us-east; 3 min after the change; record R013)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.14) (catalog, us-east; 8 min after the change; record R014)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✗ 1 other change event(s) fit about as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
✗ Two or more changes fit equally well, so the cause cannot be confirmed.
missing_data: Details to tell the competing changes apart (e.g. a rollback test)

actions.action: Fix the NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize in the catalog v3.14 release.
Monitor the error rate and request volume closely after any catalog release to catch issues early.
Roll back the new UI flow feature flag change to 50% if the error rate does not improve.
